answers.core: An add-on would be a re-implementation of the core functionality.
answers.workaround:
I'm not sure if there's an elegant way to work around this right now. None of these are particularly good:

1. Manually copying enablers throughout the tree (the simplest solution today)
2. Writing a custom FlexibleVisibilityEnabler2D that's more-or-less a clone of the implementation of the built-in one, with the ability to find nodes recursively.

title: Expose additional NodePaths to VisibilityEnabler (and VisibilityEnabler2D)
